name: Busy Diggers
hook: Tap the dirt, tap the hole. Fill the road, then a parade!
how: Your child taps a dirt pile and their digger drives over and scoops it by itself, then taps a hole to tip it in. Fill every hole together and a steamroller and a parade roll across; no reading needed, and nobody can lose.
controls: Tap or drag with one finger; the mouse works too (arrow keys drive as well)
uses: Buddy dump trucks help slowly and leave the last load to your child.
You see each other's diggers, fingers and every scoop at once.
One player's browser keeps the site and the buddies; if it leaves, the next takes over.
ideas: Make them tractors on a farm, filling the barn with hay
Add a cement mixer to the parade
Count out loud every time a load goes in
